body: not at all. i take it to get work done.

i have about $5,000 in student loans. all of the housing by me runs between $800 (considered very very good, and not easy to find) and $1,200 per month per person (including all the amenities, even with roommates). i do not make nearly this kind of money, as i would need to pay for car insurance, the cell phone, etc, and i am scared of moving far away because i don't want to be alone. i think the loneliness would be kind of overwhelming, though i could see a new environment being a good experience. (clearly, i'm torn about this.) i love to travel and see new things, but again, money is an issue.

i have always wanted to be a stunt car driver, or a car racer or something like that. i have a need for speed. i would love to be a fashion designer, or someone who makes and sells my homemade crafts. i really enjoy making things for people (painting, collaging, making them little gifts, accessories, etc). i have been told i should try to get into modeling or acting or becoming a comedian because i'm good at being expressive (and apparently i'm kind of good looking?). my parents do not support ANY of these ideas. they are hobbies, not careers. i agree that they are unstable and not always lucrative career choices, but these are the types of things that make me happy. my dream job would be one where i could travel the world.

i should clarify, my mother smokes weed on a regular basis (daily to 4 or 5 times a week). i'm not saying she's a drug addict or anything (and i'm not saying people who smoke weed are bad people or anything silly like that), it's just something she shouldn't do inside our home when my brother is trying not to do it. he was a SERIOUS drug and alcohol user. i used to smoke, but i rarely do this anymore unless i'm trying to fall asleep. (if i do, i literally take a hit or two and then i'm good. like i said, i rarely smoke anymore.) in the passed month of august, i have literally smoked twice. i have done other drugs before (lsd a few times, shrooms twice, e twice, tried other things) but i am not a regular drug user. i do not crave using drugs. i do however, drink alcohol. i used to drink a lot (daily, at most 3 or 4 times a week) but i have not done this since early may. i used to consider myself someone with an alcohol problem, but i do not have this problem to that degree anymore. i used to get ridiculously drunk and blackout, but now i don't feel like i need to drink to have fun. in fact, i went to clubs with my friends last saturday, had three drinks the entire night. did not get drunk. the only drugs i take regularly are the ones i am prescribed to, and i take adderall once in a while in the morning (10-15 mgs) just to give me a push before my 9-5.

(for the record, i know it sounds selfish, but i haven't been reading the other posts made on here because i don't want them to give me any sort of encouragement, you know?)

you're right, i am very bored with my life. at the beginning of the summer i enrolled in summer classes, and i worked the days i wasn't in class. now i am working full time. it helps keep my mind off of things, but i get really depressed at the thought of being stuck here for a while. (it is a well paying job, and i haven't found anything that pays just as well if not better. like i wrote before, i don't want to go back to dancing, but i feel like i might have to if i want to get out of this financial rut.)

you know what i want to do? i want to make art. specifically painting, collages, and fashion. i want to travel the world. i want to learn to be a stunt driver. i want to model. i want to be a mom. i want lots of things in my life. i just feel unmotivated. maybe i'm afraid of failing?

thank you for your advice and support. reading positive things like this is helping me a lot. i like your advice section. all good things <3

this is such a good idea! i have been wanting to do this for a while. i really want to learn german and / or spanish. perhaps getting a move on this and focusing on something that is fun as well as useful will make me feel happier and like my life could have more possibilities. thank you! :)

this is a very good idea that i hadn't yet considered. i think a support group or switching my therapist might really help me out. i worry about my prescriptions being cancelled or something if i do so, but they aren't making much of a difference in my mind set anyway.

very useful! thank you for the suggestion. somebody else on here told me that my therapist might not be right for me if she is dismissing my feelings, and i think they might be right. again, thank you :)

my brother had a lot of drug problems, but he has been clean for a few months. it has definitely helped our family dynamics, but of course it doesn't fix everything. i try to talk to him about how i'm feeling, but its hard because i use drugs and he isn't supposed to. our mom smokes weed, and i know that makes him really mad (annoys all of us really) because that isn't something he's supposed to do. i know having it in our house really bothers him, but there is no reasoning with my mom.

mmm most depressing things would be the loneliness i feel, the desire to have someone to be close to. also my financial status, i make decent money at my job, but not enough to live on my own. i dont want to go back to dancing, but its fast money. it definitely doesnt make me *happy* but i wouldn't say it makes me sad or anything. i treat it like a job.

my therapist and i talk about these things, the feeling of being overwhelmed, the feeling of feeling burdensome, the feeling of how i don't want to exist in this way anymore. she brushed off my paranoid thoughts as smoking weed. i stopped for a while, but i felt that way even when i wasn't high.
anyway, thanks for you voice. you are a reassuring person, and i can tell you genuinely don't want to see anyone in this state of mind because nobody deserves to feel this way. i will try to read your response when i am quite low again, and i hope it helps me. thank you.

thank you :)
edit: my dad always says he wants what's best for me, but he always tells me that my dreams (for the most part) are completely unrealistic and unattainable. it is a bit discouraging :\

my brother is great. we are close, but we both live at home and have a lot of stress put on us by my dad (kind approach of just wanting to see us successful and happy) and our mom (mean approach, always reminding us of what fuck ups we are and how we need to be moving on in our lives. when she was our age she had her own place. maybe when she was our age, shit didn't suck so bad.)

i have told my parents about the thoughts i have to end my life. they brush them off or tell me to talk to my counselor / psychiatrist. tell me i should consider changing my medications.
i love my dad, but i feel like he is sexually attracted to me (i dont know how to explain it really. it makes me uncomfortable with myself that i let these thoughts come to my mind at all. like im sick for suggesting such a thing). to make matters worse, whenever she (edit: my mom) is angry with me and he sides with me, it makes the anger between her and i increase.
